text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe showed a magnificent run even against Senior-class Umamusume.
However...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I've fallen behind...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was left behind even further... than at the Kikuka-sho...
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Cafe-san?
Thanks for your hard work tod—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Don't talk to me, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, Opera O-san, why...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Running with her made me realize. I shouldn't
get involved with her. —Not on the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She is... fundamentally different from us, after all.
"One who walks other worlds." Yes, she is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Leckermaul's Companion".

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Lekkerbek...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wasn't that wonderful, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A circle of celebration enveloped the underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. So to speak,
this is the true transitional period!
Just how far will they go, I wonder...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I'll reach it. Or rather,
I want to bear witness to reaching it.
Aaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon was riding high on excitement.
Yet Manhattan Cafe remained frozen in expression, not moving a muscle.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... My "friend" is...
My "friend"... is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She has gotten... faster.
Far faster than before...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back. The words spoken by Cafe,
who had been silent the whole time, were hard to believe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"As if responding to the fact that I've gotten faster,
she's far beyond what she was before..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Why... Why...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: WHY, WHY, WHYYY...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*twitch!*)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tsuu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sound of a cracking hoof. The sudden weight fluctuations
had certainly stopped, but even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The shadow cloaking Manhattan Cafe will not fade.
Something akin to a curse... or a ritual...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I will... catch up!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Next year, for sure...
I'm not the weak person I used to be...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what's our next objective...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It felt like a punch to the solar plexus... A powerful... thought-like sensation...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring)... 3,200 meters...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Do you mean to say that if it's that long, it will reach your 'friend'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our plan remains sound. If we're looking for our next target,
it should be a major Spring GⅠ. The Tenno Sho (Spring)
is the prime contender.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still... were those words truly born from my own will?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*crack! ――crack, crunch!*)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I will catch up to you.
Without fail... I swear it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—From a latent spring to a glorious autumn.
And so, Manhattan Cafe's Classic year came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her frailty had faded... but at the same time, a fierce craving sprouted within Manhattan Cafe.
Something powerful—and dark.
